validity.recommendation: review PipelineType: branch (газопровод-отвод) ending at GRS Yuryevets is transmission-class, not distribution; also verify Diameter (100 mm implausible) and CapacityUnits vocabulary
validity.researcher_notes: Existence confirmed by independent sources (Glavgosexpertiza-based neftegaz 2019, Ivanovo gas operator 2021, governor statements 2023): 46.49 km / 0.612 mln m3/d branch Puchezh->GRS Yuryevets, built, gas launched Dec 2022. Not a duplicate of any roster row. Classification: gem wiki says distribution but it is a gazoprovod-otvod terminating at a GRS. Spec: Diameter 100 mm unsupported and implausible; CapacityUnits 'mill.Sm3/day' off-vocab (0.612 mln m3/d=0.22 bcm/y). Status stale on sheet (see status review). gem.wiki-cited pravo.gov.ru PPT decree timed out.

verifications.note: 2022 году ... подвели газ ... в Юрьевце; пуск газа на ГРС «Юрьевец» создал условия для дальнейшей газификации Юрьевецкого района (governor, 2023-01-17)
governor 2024-08: Лух и Юрьевец — газ подводится

fills.researcher_notes: Sheet says proposed, but the Puchezh-Yuryevets branch + GRS Yuryevets were built: gas launched to GRS Yuryevets in Dec 2022 (Gazprom Mezhregiongaz release 2022-12-28 surfaced in search, mrg.gazprom.ru times out from here, NOT cited). Both cited pages are one outlet (ivteleradio) so independence=false, medium. Proposed Status=operating, StartYear1=2022. Searched for a 2nd independent commissioning source: only the gazprom.ru release found.

verifications.note: газопровод-отвод и ГРС Юрьевец, программа газификации (gas supply)
Газопровод-отвод и ГРС Юрьевец ... газификация Юрьевецкого района

fills.researcher_notes: Both pages describe a natural-gas supply branch (газоснабжение/газификация). Names hand-confirmed: 'газопровод-отвод ... между городами Пучеж и Юрьевец'.

Sheet says distribution. Sources (neftegaz 2019 Glavgosexpertiza item, gpgr-ivanovo 2021) call it a 'газопровод-отвод' (branch) from the Puchezh GRS branch ending at new GRS Yuryevets - by the classification rule a branch terminating AT a GRS is transmission, i.e. no source supports 'distribution'. Flagged in validity, not reclassified.

verifications.note: Проект реализует ПАО «Газпром» в рамках Программы развития газоснабжения и газификации регионов РФ на период 2021-2025 годы

fills.researcher_notes: ProposalYear 2021 = start of the Gazprom 2021-2025 regional programme that funds it. Note the project itself is older: Glavgosexpertiza approval reported 2019-08-19 (neftegaz) and design 'завершается' Jan 2016 (ivgazeta.ru/read/20465, not staged) - a true proposal year may be 2016-2019. Single source.

Source: 0.612 million m3/day, sheet 0.61 'mill.Sm3/day' = same number (0.612 -> 0.61 rounding). So the 'too high for DN100' worry is a diameter question, not a unit error: 0.612 mln m3/d = 0.223 bcm/y. CapacityUnits 'mill.Sm3/day' is off-vocabulary (flag; bcm/y would be 0.22). 2nd source searched (gpgr-ivanovo, Glavgosexpertiza gge.ru for Yuryevets): none states capacity.
46.49 km exactly matches the Glavgosexpertiza-based neftegaz item; the operator-side 2021 page says 46.32 km (0.4% lower, as-built/route revision). Recorded 46.49 kept; discrepancy noted.

Sheet 100 mm. Opened neftegaz 481224, gpgr-ivanovo 9847, ivteleradio 2023/2024: none states a diameter; pravo.gov.ru planning decree (cited on gem.wiki) times out. 100 mm looks too small for a 46 km, ~5.4 MPa, 0.61 mln m3/d branch (DN200-300 more usual) - filed as spec concern, no candidate value.

fills.researcher_notes: Start = tie-in to the branch to GRS Puchezh, end = GRS Yuryevets (near Shikhovo). Start/End state spelling differs on the sheet (region vs Oblast) - vocabulary note only.

GPGR names PAO Gazprom as implementer; neftegaz names subsidiary Gazprom Mezhregiongaz (customer/developer). Ownership % (100) is an inference from that. Gazprom Mezhregiongaz may be the legal holder - left as recorded.
